liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Jam is extremely fast and furious, described as blistering; Standout: Jerry pulls out all the stops with Brent close behind, and transitions swing between gentle and furious [17][18]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Reviewer liked the late-1970s version and saw the band bring it back during 1984 [14]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Decent, as usual [18]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Has strong jams, and with Let It Grow it signals a good second set [22]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Jerry's gravelly voice adds a bluesy feel, and there is an excellent solo at the end [18]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet into Fire is called stellar [15]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): A personal all-time favorite, with emotionally torn, longing orchestration; the Scarlet before it is merely okay [17]
- **Far From Me** (1 review): Reviewer has always liked it, though notes some of Brent's songs lean negative [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-30.aud.walker-scotton.miller.106168.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 164 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Full, beautiful audience recording, among the best 1984 audience tapes the reviewer has heard [22]
- **gd1984-10-30.175945.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 157 min [2]
- **gd84-10-30.mixed.ladner.22256.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 153 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Mostly clean soundboard for most of the show [23]
- **gd84-10-30.senn.vernon.17415.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 142 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds excellent, with an open, outdoor-like quality; Reviewer rates the audience recording very good [15][20]
- **gd1984-10-30.179388.unknown.shotguns.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 156 min [7]
- **gd1984-10-30.168288.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 153 min [9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls the venue a wonderful small place to see the band [23]
- Reviewer says the three shows before this run overshadowed these two, though they still value the tapes [14]
- Typical of 1984: Brent's 80s keyboard sound and Jerry's strained vocals [16]
- Despite a familiar 70s/80s-standards setlist, Jerry's energy makes the songs feel fresh, unlike similar-looking shows [21]
- Fall 1984 tour had many good shows; reviewer attended two [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-30.aud.walker-scotton.miller.106168.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Unknown Mics -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/Dolby B/TDK MA-R90) [1]
- **gd1984-10-30.175945.marantz.superscope.terry.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Terry; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Terry's Master Audience Cassettes; Marantz Superscope EC-9P mics > Sony WM-D6C (Maxell XLII-S90) [2]. Also: Jim Vita's Sennheiser 441 tape fills crowd noise, the start of Far From Me, and a Drums to Space patch [2]
- **gd84-10-30.mixed.ladner.22256.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1: SBD>MC>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN. Set 2: SBD>MC>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN & AUD(Senn 441Âs>Sony D-5)>MC>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [4]
- **gd84-10-30.senn.vernon.17415.sbeok.shnf**: source: Senn 441Âs>Sony D-5. Lineage: AUD>MC>DAT>CDR via Raoul Duke encoded by Willy Munder and Matt Vernon [6]
- **gd1984-10-30.179388.unknown.shotguns.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; Unknown shotgun mics > Sony TC-D5M [7]. Also: Sennheiser 441 source patches Estimated to Eyes transition, part of Eyes Of The World, and the end of Sunshine Daydream [7]
- **gd1984-10-30.168288.senn441.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > ?? > Jim Vita's cassettes (Maxell XLII-S) [9]. Also: Nakamichi 300 tape from Walker and Scotton patches Let It Grow, Scarlet, post-Eyes jam, and a long section of Drums; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [9]

- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-10-30 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-10-30-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [27]
